item.description:
### New
- The Home hero is now picked for you. It shows newer films and shows similar to what you're at least 40% through, instead of whatever is popular. Drag across it, or swipe with two fingers on a trackpad, to move to the next one. - Remove a title from Continue Watching by right-clicking its card, or with Clear Progress on the film's page. It's removed from your account's watch history too, so it won't come back from another device. - The "Who's watching?" screen has bigger profile pictures.
### Better
- Trailers before a movie no longer buffer. Each one downloads in full before it plays, while the next one downloads in the background. - Restart now really starts the movie from the beginning, and plays the trailers first. - Leaving a movie takes you back to its page rather than the list of sources. - Anything you've started shows on Continue Watching, even if you only watched a minute or two.
